messages:
Nina (CS): FYI AuroraHealth renewal in ~5w. Usage down ~52% last 2w. They filed a ticket about slow tails and some truncated chat replies on staging. Procurement wants a short reliability note for their RFP.
Omar (Solutions): Do we have request IDs or specific endpoints?
Nina (CS): They call out /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings. Errors cluster 14:00-15:00 CET. Sample lines from their bundle:
```
2026-03-05T14:12:07Z 500 generation err="kv_cache_miss" latency=2.1s
2026-03-05T14:45:22Z 502 batch_timeout batch_size=1
```
Lea (Eng): Pattern looks like bursty small requests -> batch collapse and cold KV. I can run a quick replay on staging to validate. ETA ~3h.
Sam (AE): Procurement is likely comparing us to NimbusAI. They want latency numbers and a mitigation plan. Prefer we offer a reliability trial rather than a discount.
Nina (CS): New procurement contact: Asha R. 64 non-technical. Their ML lead is out, so we need a one-page exec summary + a short ops checklist for their engineer.
Omar (Solutions): Proposed immediate steps: 1) reproduce with their trace; 2) offer a 2-week dedicated routing trial during their eval window; 3) provide a 1-pager with client tweaks (reduce max_wait to 25ms, enable streaming retries). I'll draft the docs.
infra-bot: Canary deploy scheduled 2026-03-06T02:00Z. Noted by @Lea (Eng).
Lea (Eng): I'll exclude Aurora's tenant from the canary and run the replay. If we confirm, quick fix: lower tenant max_wait and increase tenant concurrency.
Sam (AE): I'll push for trial on the call and gather their RFP scoring sheet.
Nina (CS): Action items: Omar - exec + ops one-pagers (owner: Omar) EOD; Lea - reproduce + logs + config patch (owner: Lea) in 3h; Sam - confirm competitive set & procurement asks before meeting (owner: Sam) EOD; Nina - schedule 30m call with procurement tomorrow.
Omar (Solutions): Draft uploaded: https://docs.company/aurora/reliability-note-draft PTAL.
Nina (CS): Reviewed, left comments to add fallback model variant and a 2-week stabilization SLA tied to the trial.
Lea (Eng): If we get truncated examples, pls paste them here. Could be client-side timeout or server-side early termination.
Nina (CS): Will collect examples from ticket and share in the meeting. Thanks team. :pray:
